spec.description: Books: unified library across Kindle and WeRead (微信读书). Browse, search, scan from multiple sources, view enriched metadata, deep AI podcasts, and research from your reading.

tools.label: Browse Books
tools.description: Browse your book collection from all sources (Kindle + WeRead). Supports tabs (all/kindle/weread), filtering by category, search, sorting, and pagination.

tools.label: Search Books
tools.description: Search your book library across all sources by title, author, or keyword.

query.description: Search query (matches title, author, description, categories)

tools.label: Scan Kindle
tools.description: Scan your Amazon Kindle library via read.amazon.com. Requires Amazon login session.

tools.label: Scan WeRead
tools.description: Scan your WeRead (微信读书) library via weread.qq.com. Requires WeChat login — use /browser to log in first.

tools.label: Add Book
tools.description: Search for a book by title, author, or ISBN across 4 sources (Google Books, WeRead, Douban, Amazon Kindle) and add it to your library.

query.description: Book title, author name, or ISBN to search for

tools.label: Enrich Kindle Metadata
tools.description: Fetch rich metadata (descriptions, ratings, categories, page counts) from Amazon product pages for Kindle books.

tools.label: Update Libraries
tools.description: Incremental scan — check for new books across all sources and update the Cortex.
